description: Write a JSON object matching this schema. Tables ordered supplier_id, then fiscal_period, then variant; no duplicate business keys. Actions are unordered sets. Quantities and days exact integers; booleans strict. Money integers in fen, final half-up rounding and 1-fen tolerance. Extra explanations/source_references/recommendation permitted and unscored.
